snippet.title: Jump The Track Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
You're Sam, a young dreamer struggling in the gig economy. However, tonight may change everything. In this absurd comedy, fight your inner battles, rally your forces, and get ready to overthrow the system!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2946390/Jump_the_Track/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
https://youtube.com/sixoneindie
